messages:
support-bot: FYI from Acme Corp — billing spike on private VPC for tenant acme-inc. Customer sees 3x tokens on invoice vs dashboard.
maya: Got the forwarded ticket. Can someone pull the agent logs for the customer VPC? customer reported an agent restart around 2024-10-12T02:30Z.
arjun: I'm on it. Quick q: are we sure this is metering agent (onprem) and not an ingestion duplicate at the collector? maya: Agent (v1.8.2) running on their jumpbox, using local buffering to S3. They said they did an OS patch and reboot around that time.
maya: Pulled agent logs from S3. See repeated replay of the same seq range after restart. Snippet:

```
2024-10-12T02:29:55Z INFO flush buffer partition=3 from_seq=120045 to_seq=120120 tokens=4821
2024-10-12T02:30:02Z INFO agent shutdown requested
2024-10-12T02:30:10Z INFO recover buffer from s3 key=s3://acme-metering/queues/3/120045-120120.json
2024-10-12T02:30:11Z INFO replaying seq_start=120045 seq_end=120120 tokens_sent=4821
2024-10-12T02:30:12Z WARN send failed, retrying: http 502
2024-10-12T02:30:13Z INFO replaying seq_start=120045 seq_end=120120 tokens_sent=4821
```

maya: That double replay looks suspicious — same seq range sent twice.
sam: Ops side: collector accepted both and returned 200. Collector idempotency currently uses (client_id, partition, seq) but only when the producer marks ack; if agent crash happens before ack persistence we can see dup delivery. ricardo: Also noticed clock drift of ~90s on the agent host vs the collector; logs show timestamps of the second batch slightly earlier in collector time which may confuse reconciliation.
arjun: Customer audit log shows these seqs present twice with different event_ids (uuid). So duplicate ingestion -> tokens counted twice in billing ledger. Need reconciliation and dedupe rules.
maya: Repro steps for me locally:

1) run agent v1.8.2 with local sqlite ledger
2) artificially kill agent immediately after http 200 returned but before writing last_ack (race)
3) bring agent back -> agent will read buffered files and resend same seq range

Command snippets I used:

```
# start agent
./meter-agent --conf acme.yaml
# kill after response window
pkill -USR1 meter-agent  # simulate abrupt shutdown
# restart
./meter-agent --conf acme.yaml
# check ledger
sqlite3 /var/lib/meter-agent/ledger.db "select seq, status, last_sent from ledger where partition=3 order by seq desc limit 5;"
```

arjun: Patch proposal: agent must persist last_ack(seq) synchronously before returning success to caller OR use an ack-on-confirmation background step with a safe-on-disk marker. Short term, we can implement server-side dedupe by ignoring duplicates where (client_id, partition, seq) already exists in meter table.
ricardo: For customer compensation we should run a one-off reconciliation: generate list of dup seqs and subtract duplicated token counts from their invoice. I can run a query on billing ledger to find seq groups with count>1. SQL snippet:

```
SELECT client_id, partition, seq, count(*) as hits, sum(tokens) as tokens_total
FROM metered_events
WHERE client_id='acme-inc' AND ts >= '2024-10-12'
GROUP BY client_id, partition, seq
HAVING hits > 1;
```

sam: Also check S3 staging path for repeated objects. If agent uploaded multiple buffered files with same seq range different object names that explains duplicate ingestion. We should add dedupe metadata to object keys.
maya: Immediate mitigation for customer: 1) run reconciliation and credit duplicated tokens 2) push collector-side dedupe (ignore duplicates if seen) 3) schedule agent hotfix for v1.8.3 to persist ack before reporting success. Who owns the collector change? @sam can you prioritize a short-term filter?
sam: Yes, will prioritize. Quick filter: if (client_id, partition, seq) exists, drop message but return 200 to agent. I'll open a PR today.
arjun: I'll prepare the agent patch and tests for crash-after-ack race. Also add extra logging: ledger flush points and durable fsync on ack file.
ricardo: I'll prepare the reconciliation and customer credit estimate — ETA 4 hours.
maya: Thanks team. I'll reply to support ticket with interim update: investigating, applied collector filter, running reconciliation.
support-bot: Incident milestone: created incident INC-2024-773, severity P2, notify oncall.
ops-bot: Automations: scheduled reconciliation job started at 2024-10-12T06:00Z. Output will be attached to the ticket when done.
maya: Follow-ups: add unit test for replay dedupe, add agent config knob `--persist-acks=true` default on. Also add an ops playbook note for customers doing OS reboots: graceful drain command `meter-agent drain --timeout 60s`.
ricardo: Customer compensation proposal: credit duplicated tokens + apology + offer one-month discounted Dedicated plan (optional) — will draft email.
maya: Closing loop: once collector filter and reconciliation complete we can close the support ticket. I'll post final summary here. :white_check_mark:
